name: bws-mask
description: Screen-share masking for recordings and demos: /mask draws emails, phone numbers, money amounts, keys and tokens, your account name and your own terms as same-length bars in the transcript. Only the screen changes; Claude still reads the real data. A Mask tab in the dashboard shows the mode, what is hidden and what is not covered.

terms.title: Terms to hide
terms.description: Names, codenames or anything else to hide while masking is on, separated by commas. Matched whole, any case.
